projects.name: PROOF (ANR-19-CE22-0008)
projects.summary: The PROOF project aims to compare roofing systems and assess their energy-environmental impact and performance in relation to contrasting urban development scenarios and the associated territorial issues. In particular, we study an innovative biosolar green roof system which is the combination of a green roof and a photovoltaic panel.
